notes.title: Painting Werther is killing it today!
notes.notes:
We are so happy to announce so many things!

First, we are participating in both Tiny Teams by Yogscast and the Steam's Visual Novel Fest with Painting Werther.

We are also finally releasing the OST for Painting Werther. 100+ minutes of music from the game plus 2 extra songs, so you can relive all the tribulations of the young Werther.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38245054/ae307e64ac15a31b0253e70daedcc9950e34901b.png[/img]

The OST will include both the .mp3 and .flac versions of the music, and buying it will help us so much developing new and exciting games.

But there are also news for Pink Gum as well!

We are in our biggest discount yet in all our products: Pink Gum, Painting Werther and their soundtracks!!!

And if all of that wasn't enough, we are releasing a Mad Cream Games bundle, so you can buy all of our products in one go, or just buy the ones that you are still missing.

notes.title: Pink Gum is two years old!!!
notes.notes:
We are celebrating our second anniversary from the release of Pink Gum!!!

We are having a discount, a new bundle and a giveaway on twitter to celebrate this event!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38245054/cbac2fa7f28e91926a674f504adb7a38c3570659.png[/img]

Thank you all for the support, and your patience for Painting Werther. We are on a late beta stage, with reviewing and cleaning and some assets missing. We really are looking to have a release date very soon!

Thank you again for the kinds words we receive almost daily. We are extremely thankful

We will keep you posted!

notes.title: We just released an updated Demo for Painting Werther
notes.notes:
Hello!

We wanted to tell you that we updated the Painting Werther demo, by adding a tutorial, some new gameplay features and fixed some bugs that have come to our attention.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1434260/Painting_Werther/

We thank you for your patience in the development, we know we have been quiet about our work, but we really are working as hard as we can!

We are currently starting to discuss a date for the launch, so stay tuned!

Thank you again for everything and for all the people who believe in this project and in us!!!

We hope you are as excited as we are for the release!!!

Best regards,

Mad Cream Games

notes.title: The Pink Gum OST is out now!
notes.notes:
The Pink Gum's Original SoundTrack is available to purchase right now!

From buying it, you get access to .wav and .mp3 files of all 5 original songs from the game.

If you want to invite us to a coffee, this would be a great help for us to keep working in games such as Painting Werther and more ideas we have yet to announce. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1434260/Painting_Werther/?utm_source=pgost

Either way, we still remind you that the OST is available on our YouTube channel for free.

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkswxCY3bdGoJOet7TXQU8EIFlvwZtZvO

We also support the use of it in your videos or other social media content of any kind. The only thing we ask is for you to clarify Pink Gum as the source of the music. It really helps us out!

We hope you enjoy it and thank you for your interest!


Mad Cream Games

notes.title: Announcing the Soundtrack of Pink Gum
notes.notes:
After a lot of work and love from the musician in our company, we are finally publishing the soundtrack for Pink Gum here on Steam!!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899490/Pink_Gum_Soundtrack/?utm_source=pgost

You can already find it for free on Youtube, but buying it here on Steam will support us financially and will help us create more games with the artistic freedom we are so proud to have.

[previewyoutube=hQA_3JZSHXk;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to also allow people to use our OST as they please, from background music to their videos to any other purpose. We only ask to be credited if you do use it so we can help each other.

More news will come in the near future so stay tuned!

notes.title: One year ago...
notes.notes:
One year ago we released PinkGum, our first game.
A lot have happened since: we got a 90% review on Steam, we received an Honorable Mention at Independent Game Festival and we started the even weirder and more artistic Painting Werther

Thank you for coming with us on the beginning of this adventure.

notes.title: Pink Gum out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38245054/82e504440745d68e20471f30b4861fff7c12af6f.jpg[/img]

We are finally releasing our [b]first game[/b]!!!

We are so [b]excited [/b]about today! (Some of us didn't even sleep...). 
When we started a year ago, we were just experimenting and going crazy with this idea. 
We never really belived we would get here today, and it's so [b]overwhelming[/b]!!!

[b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who has whishlisted and has followd us this last few weeks. 
We truly hope that you [b]love[/b] this game as much as we do!
